insights.one_liner: Alvarez & Marsal is a global consulting firm known for hands-on restructuring and advisory work, an IND sponsor with an Amsterdam consulting internship.

culture.text: Describes itself as entrepreneurial and hands-on, with values of integrity, quality, objectivity, fun, personal reward and inclusive diversity.
Its one open role here is a consulting internship in Amsterdam, averaging 126 LinkedIn applicants.

open.text: Recognised IND visa sponsor through Alvarez & Marsal Benelux B.V.
Its one internship here is not marked as Dutch-optional.

growth.text: Expanded its commercial due diligence practice with three senior hires to meet client demand.
Its transaction advisory group is growing in Germany as EMEA demand strengthens.
Hired a former Celerant Consulting chief for its Brussels office.

worth_knowing.text: Lebanon picked it for a new audit of the country's central bank, showing the high-profile work it does.
